package.name: valtoryn_facility
package.description: Valtoryn internal facility model (nodes, edges, zones, assets), exporters to LIF / RMF nav graph / Nav2 GeoJSON / VDA 5050 order segments, and the minimal reservation/queue fleet-coordination baseline per docs/architecture/FACILITY_AND_FLEET_LAYER.md and docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_RECORDS.md ADR-008. Status: software layer implemented; no ROS runtime is required to use it, and no capability is validated on physical hardware.
